concept: One whiteboard that fills as the reasoning is drawn. Maya's four urgent cards start as a list worked in arrival order; two questions become the axes of an impact and effort board; each card is placed, acted on, then its zone is named; the reply note and the week strip sit beside the board; at the close the camera pans back to the first list, now sorted again by the board.
world: One whiteboard, two stations side by side: 'list' (x 0) holds Maya's Monday list and the urgent split; 'matrix' (x 2400) holds the impact and effort board on the left two thirds with a right-hand column for the week strip, the reply note and the new card. Camera pans right at b04, back left at b13.

devices.what: Maya's four request cards (client reply, budget report, expenses, deck redesign): the same rough card all lesson, its state changes on the spoken word (urgent tag, tick, placed, later tag)
the impact and effort board: the two questions of b04 become its axis labels, four zones are named as each move is taught
a hand-drawn Monday to Friday strip where big work becomes one solid block instead of scraps
a written reply note tied by an arrow to the budget report card, with a date and a smaller version under it
one whiteboard: a camera pan to the next part of the board and back to the first list at the close

sections.treatment: presenter opens, then the list is drawn and worked top down

beats.line: the presenter, Monday, all four requests say urgent
Maya's four cards in a list, each tagged urgent; ticks run down in arrival order, a clock moves to Friday, the budget report is left unticked

sections.treatment: urgent split on the list board, then a pan to the matrix board where the questions become axes and the cards are placed

beats.line: the word urgent split into how soon and how much it matters; a drawn balance tips to the deadline side
pan right to a clean part of the board: Impact? and Effort? written large
the questions become the axes; the client reply card lands high on the left
budget report high right, expenses low left, deck redesign low right

sections.treatment: act on each card, then name its zone, same board

beats.line: dividers make four zones; the client reply is ticked, then top left is named quick wins, do first
top right named major projects; scattered budget scraps in the week strip become one solid block
fill-ins bracketed as a batch; the deck card gets a later tag in the thankless zone

sections.treatment: the reply note drafted beside the board

beats.line: a reply note in the right column, an arrow to the budget report card, two options written under it

sections.treatment: a new card to place, its answer, then the pan back to the list sorted again

beats.line: a new unplaced card arrives in the right column: New analysis by Friday, Where does it go?; the board waits
the card lands top right; a second block in the week strip; a question arrow to the other cards: which task gives way?
pan back to the first list: the rows travel into the board's order, Place it. Sort again. as heading, start with a quick win underlined
